eps_k_conflict_resolved.rule: GPT round-19 sec.17: go back to the final script output; do not average, do not choose from memory.
eps_k_conflict_resolved.root_cause: the two earlier scripts used different sampling: gate16_theory_diagnostics.py computed eps_k with stride 1 over the full k-range (median 0.3454), while gate16_diag_fix.py used stride 4 with a shorter k-range (median 0.3473). d_M / product norms were stride 4 in BOTH, hence identical.
eps_k_conflict_resolved.resolution: new single-source script gate16_diag_final.py recomputes eps_k, d_abs, d_M, product norms, L_F, Prop.2 ratio and Cor.1 ratio under ONE documented sampling (stride 1 for eps_k and the rollout diagnostics; L_F unchanged sampling). Output: gate16_diag_final.json.
eps_k_conflict_resolved.confirmed: eps_k median = 0.345 -> matches the frozen round-18 value; the 0.347 was the stride-4 subsample.
eps_k_conflict_resolved.paper_table_updated: eps_k 0.345/0.567; d_abs 0.346/1.122/1.645/2.663; Prop.2 ratio 1.64/2.77/4.22/6.52x; Cor.1 text 53-47750x; footnote documents the sampling
